items.claim: Zone transfer or a misconfigured DNS service reveals the internal host inventory that no port scan would expose.
items.body:
In practice on HTB this shows up as: If we start a Python program by calling a py file, and there we call `"__name__"`, the system assigns it to the system variable the identifier "`__main__`." However, if we import this file into another module, it gets an identifier corresponding to the file name. This construction uses a Python file as a stand-alone program, makes single elements of this file importable, and implements complex module tests. As we did with the `AXFR` function, we proceed accordingly and define the rough steps that need to be taken as comments.

Write-up provenance: Esther7171/HackTheBox-Writeups-Walkthroughs :: Write-ups/Academy/02. Information Gathering/10b. DNS Enumeration Python/DNS Enumeration Using Python.md (8215 words, classified network).
items.disproof: Refuted when the authoritative server refuses AXFR and out-of-zone queries, so the internal inventory is never returned.
